main_text.head: INSTITVTIONIS DIALECTICAE LIBER IIII.
CAP. I.
main_text.p: QUONIAM de inuetione Medij Syllogistici satis dixisti, deinceps de ipsius collocatione videamus: quam iudicandi artem superius Analyticen appellabas. Sed primum quæro, quid est Analytice? Est ars, quæ medij ad utrunque quæstionis extremum adhibendi rationem commonstrat.

Quisnam eius artis est usus? Probatio cōsecutionis, qua pronuntiata omnia vel ut vera recipiuntur, vel ut falsa repudiantur. Nam ut in ædificiis, alius est faber, qui lapides lapidibus adiungit: alius peritus, cuius arbitrio effectum opus probatur: sic oratio verba verbis adiungit: sed Analyticæ artis probatio est, utrum ea inter se rectè coniuncta sint, an secus.

page.notes: The large initial is an ornamental woodcut letter read as Q; the initial is joined to "UONIAM" in the transcription. Long s is rendered as s throughout. Printed "vt", "vsus", "vel" and "vera" were corrected to ut, usus, vel and vera per the u/v rule. The line "De Analytice,siue" has no space after the comma in print. The catchword "De" is printed at the lower right. No running head, since the page opens a new division.
